name: Igor Pankin
headline: Finance Systems & ERP Product Lead
tagline: 20 years in financial ERP and FinTech: Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle ERP Cloud implementation, custom development, SaaS/PaaS and integrations, delivery with P&L ownership — and AI-agent automation on the side.

experience.description: Formal title: Lead Consultant. Delivery and P&L ownership for financial ERP projects and for in-house products taken to customers. Customers by request.
highlights: Delivered a portfolio of 6 projects (2014–2025): over €4.5M revenue and about €1.4M profit, ROI above 30%; own scope, budget, team and P&L

Led the migration of a large enterprise's financial ERP platform (applications, integrations, reports, data) with no interruption to financial close; implemented financial and tax modules for an industrial customer
Supported sales of large telecom, chemicals, energy and mining deals: proposals, estimates, sales materials
Automated IFRS and management P&L reporting for group finance

experience.description: Formal title: Senior Consultant (Lead Consultant from 2021). Project management and product ownership for Oracle ERP financial solutions as an Oracle Platinum partner.
highlights: Delivered an Oracle ERP Cloud implementation for a major enterprise customer alongside its international head-office team and a global integrator
Built a SaaS product from scratch as an extension of Oracle ERP and took it to customers
Developed and distributed the official Oracle localisation solution for Russia
Ran a multi-year PaaS-based support contract for a large customer

experience.description: Development, enhancement and functional support of financial ERP applications for global industrial and retail customers (names by request).
highlights: Owned functional design and development of financial modules, reports and localisation features for global industrial and retail customers; kept one retail ERP customer for 10+ years

experience.description: Custom financial software development and implementation of Treasury applications for energy, chemicals and utilities customers. Part of IBS Group (IBS Borlas practice) until 2012.
highlights: Delivered Treasury applications for energy, chemicals and utilities customers, with business process improvement

experience.description: Oracle E-Business Suite financials implementation in one of the biggest projects in Russia, for a state telecom holding; also GL, budgeting, cash flow and treasury modules for large telecom operators.
highlights: Took part in the Oracle EBS financials implementation (GL, CE, TR, AP) for a state telecom holding; project went live on time
Wrote functional designs, tested modules, trained junior consultants and key users

experience.description: Building autonomous agent systems that orchestrate workflows across messaging, scheduling, data pipelines and third-party APIs.
highlights: Built omb-agent, a multi-agent platform (LangGraph, RAG, MCP skills) that runs my own workflows across messaging, scheduling and data pipelines
Telegram assistant and data pipelines: LLM digests, Gmail and Google Photos integrations
Self-hosted Kubernetes platform with CI/CD, Cloudflare Access and observability

items: Oracle ERP Cloud / Oracle Fusion Applications
